verdict.rationale: Docusign's REST API, Node SDK, and web-forms embedding features (docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-40, docusign-docs-43) document first-party support for embedding signing/forms into third-party apps, and some developers report smooth embedded-signing integrations (docusign-comm-4, docusign-comm-5). However, a concrete hands-on report describes a security flaw in the embedded signing flow (users could break out of the signing iframe and view account data) that required Docusign to push a legacy API workaround with no sunset guarantee (docusign-comm-1), directly contradicting the polished 'seamless embed' narrative for at least one real integration. missing for 10: independent verification the security issue was fully resolved in current API versions, and a first-party embedded-signing quickstart/guide in the evidence pack.
